resolution.note: scope hook refuses every write outside the lane worktree; lane-target admits one foreign path

title: The lane scope guard refuses every write outside the worktree the same way, with an explicit foreign target
body:
Observed 2026-11-19 (toolchain sweep): the lane scope hook refused a Bash write to krn-codex-skills/.node-version from a krn-lane ("outside this lane's worktree"), yet sibling krn-lane agents launched the same way in the same minute edited and committed files in other repositories (visual-builder-CF7 041b0fc, 3d-wkladki-wp 396ec36, podolog-warszawa 9cceae3). The guard is inconsistent: either every write outside the lane worktree is refused (Bash, Edit, Write, git -C) or the lead can grant a lane an explicit foreign target.
Files: src/hook/scope.ts, test/hook/
Outcome: a hook test shows the same verdict for an Edit, a Write and a Bash redirect to a path outside the lane worktree, and a brief line (for example 'lane-target: <path>') admits one named foreign repository.
Proof: node --test of the lane scope hook covering Edit, Write and Bash outside the worktree prints pass.
